entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
James Miller. Order is VF-551-9B. Or something.

Thank you, James. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloPro cycling shoes. To make sure I'm assisting correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit. I keep getting terrible blisters right over the area where the cleats attach.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Uncomfortable cycling shoes can ruin a ride.

Let me just check the purchase date for you... I see you received them 79 days ago. According to our policy for standard items, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Wow. A company that actually follows its own policy. A miracle.

Of course. I've just processed that return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label shortly. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.

And Mr. Miller, I do see you're a VIP member with us and we really appreciate your loyalty. For the trouble with the fit and the blisters, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase. No expiration.
Great, that's all set for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
